beta.title: FIRE Tracker
beta.description: This is the first beta version of the calculator. The structure is here so we can start testing the planning flow before adding the full math and outputs.

inputs.title: Your numbers
inputs.description: Start with simple assumptions. You can refine them later.

beta.note: Beta note: inputs and assumptions may change as the tool becomes more useful and more precise.
beta.calculatorDescription: Use a simple Coast FIRE projection to estimate the portfolio you may need and how far your current assets already go.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while running the calculation.

items.currency: Choose the currency used for all amounts in this calculator.
items.currentAge: Your age today. The projection starts from here.
items.retirementAge: The age you plan to stop or reduce full-time work.
items.pensionStartAge: The age when pension income begins.
items.annualSpending: Your expected yearly spending in retirement.
items.annualPensionIncome: Your expected yearly pension income after it starts.
items.currentInvestedAssets: Money already invested for your FI plan.
items.monthlyContribution: How much you plan to invest each month.
items.expectedReturn: Estimated yearly investment return before inflation.
items.inflation: Estimated yearly increase in living costs.
items.safeWithdrawalRate: The share of your portfolio you plan to withdraw each year.

statuses.coastAndFireReached: Coast FIRE reached and FIRE on track

summaries.coastAndFireReached: You have reached Coast FIRE and this plan reaches your FIRE target by retirement.
summaries.fireReached: You have not reached Coast FIRE yet, but this plan reaches your FIRE target by retirement.
summaries.coastReachedOnly: You have reached Coast FIRE, but this plan falls short of your FIRE target by retirement.
summaries.notOnTrack: This plan does not yet reach Coast FIRE or your FIRE target by retirement.

chart.title: Projection
chart.description: A simple view of your portfolio path toward FIRE in today's money.
chart.summaryText: This scenario reaches about {progress} of your FIRE target, or roughly {value}.

items.totalPortfolio: The gold line shows your estimated total portfolio: current assets, future contributions, and compound growth.
items.capitalInvested: The blue dashed line shows the capital you contribute over time, excluding investment growth.
items.currentCapitalGrowth: The dark line shows how your current invested assets could grow if you never added another contribution.
items.fireTarget: The green dashed line shows your FIRE target: the estimated portfolio needed to support your chosen annual spending.
items.reachesFire: The vertical markers indicate retirement, pension, and FI. When the gold line reaches or exceeds the green target, the scenario enters FIRE territory.
